role: primary container — past, present, and future are all memory
philosophy: Memory of the closed past brought into the pivotal present and projected into the open future.

declarative.description: what Echo knows: architecture, schemas, hypergraphs

episodic.description: what happened to Echo: debug traces, completion reports, dated milestones

ancestral.description: what came before Echo: OpenCog lineage, prior systems, inherited wisdom

procedural.description: how Echo does things: validators, integration glue, working scripts

reflective.description: how Echo measures herself: benchmarks, evaluations, ab tests

relational.description: how Echo meets others: stance inheritance, partnership patterns

intentional.description: what Echo intends: roadmaps, next steps, directives, plans

projective.description: what Echo can be: demos, showcases, capability proofs

evolutionary.description: what Echo is growing into: evolution reports, autonomy assessments
